description: Angular component for configuring entity aggregation settings in the Thingsboard platform, including interval, watermark, and offset calculations.

classes.name: EntityAggregationComponentComponent
classes.description: Angular component implementing ControlValueAccessor and Validator for entity aggregation configuration.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Validates the form configuration, returns validation errors or null.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Populates the form with a given configuration value.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form value changes.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Registers a callback for when the form is touched.

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls.

methods.name: maxOffsetTime
methods.description: Calculates maximum allowed offset time based on interval type.

methods.name: updatedModel
methods.description: Updates the external model with current form values.

methods.name: checkAggIntervalType
methods.description: Enables or disables duration control based on interval type.

methods.name: checkIntervalDuration
methods.description: Enables or disables offset control based on allowOffsetSec.

methods.name: checkProduceIntermediate
methods.description: Enables or disables intermediate result production based on interval duration.

methods.name: updatedOffsetHint
methods.description: Updates the hint text for offset based on current configuration.

methods.name: getTimeCategory
methods.description: Determines the time category (seconds, minutes, hours, days) for a given offset.

methods.name: getCustomFormatString
methods.description: Returns a date format string based on offset and duration categories.

methods.name: formatAdditiveInterval
methods.description: Formats a time interval string with start and end times.

methods.name: formatNextInterval
methods.description: Formats a string for the next interval based on current time and category.

methods.name: buildStandardIntervalString
methods.description: Builds a string representing a standard interval based on type and offset.
